title: Renewable energy Bitcoin mining initiatives expand globally
content: TL;DR: The global shift towards renewable energy in Bitcoin mining is rapidly accelerating, fortifying the network's security and dismantling long-standing environmental FUD. With current network hashrate at 896.87 EH/s and a difficulty adjustment imminent, transactors should recognize this trend as a fundamental strengthening of Bitcoin's monetary sovereignty against fiat debasement. This pivotal moment underscores Bitcoin's role as a decentralized, self-correcting system, driven by economic incentives towards sustainable energy use.
author: Al Ingle
